mapper.select: SELECT ratio_id as ratioId, period_id as periodId, dept_id as deptId, grade_s_ratio as gradeSRatio, grade_a_ratio as gradeARatio, grade_b_ratio as gradeBRatio, grade_c_ratio as gradeCRatio, grade_d_ratio as gradeDRatio FROM evaluation_grade_ratios_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO evaluation_grade_ratios_51 AS target USING (SELECT #{periodId} AS period_id, #{deptId} AS dept_id, #{gradeSRatio} AS s_ratio, #{gradeARatio} AS a_ratio, #{gradeBRatio} AS b_ratio, #{gradeCRatio} AS c_ratio, #{gradeDRatio} AS d_ratio) AS source ON target.period_id = source.period_id AND (target.dept_id = source.dept_id OR (target.dept_id IS NULL AND source.dept_id IS NULL)) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET grade_s_ratio = source.s_ratio, grade_a_ratio = source.a_ratio, grade_b_ratio = source.b_ratio, grade_c_ratio = source.c_ratio, grade_d_ratio = source.d_ratio, updated_at = GETDATE() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (period_id, dept_id, grade_s_ratio, grade_a_ratio, grade_b_ratio, grade_c_ratio, grade_d_ratio) VALUES (source.period_id, source.dept_id, source.s_ratio, source.a_ratio, source.b_ratio, source.c_ratio, source.d_ratio);
